The role requires establishing robust control frameworks and governance standards, ensuring compliance with accounting policies, and maintaining the integrity of financial systems. The position supports decision-making by providing high-quality financial insights and leading financial strategies, collaborating with various stakeholders to drive financial and operational success. Act as the main reference on complex accounting judgements and interpretations across CFC. Lead impact assessments of new and amended accounting standards and ensure consistent implementation across all entities. Ensure accounting policies are embedded within systems, processes, and finance operations. Internal Control Framework, Systems & Standards Own and enforce the Al-Futtaim financial control framework across CFC as Head of Internal Controlling. Ensure compliance with control standards across all CFC business units and legal entities. Drive continuous improvement of internal controls through process redesign, automation, and system enhancements. Govern finance systems and SAP-interfaced platforms to ensure data integrity and control robustness. Sponsor and govern legal entity and SAP entity rationalization initiatives. Financial Close, Consolidation & Reporting Governance Be fully accountable for the integrity, discipline, and timeliness of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close. Establish and enforce balance sheet substantiation standards across all entities. Oversee intercompany accounting, reconciliation, settlement, and policy compliance. Lead CFC consolidation and ensure accuracy of divisional and system-driven consolidation processes. Approve and govern financial master data. Financial Control, Governance & Compliance Act as senior owner of financial governance, ensuring compliance with policies, DOA, and regulatory requirements. Oversee FSSC performance against KPIs and SLAs, ensuring a strong control environment. Govern onboarding and offboarding of entities into shared services and finance systems. Review, challenge, and ensure closure of internal and external audit findings, including tax-related matters. Ensure accuracy, reliability, and completeness of financial records and statutory reporting. Financial Reporting & Strategic Analysis Own the integrity and quality of management and statutory financial reporting across CFC. Provide senior leadership with insightful analysis across key financial cycles (revenue, leasing, working capital, funding, investments). Translate financial performance into risks, opportunities, and actionable insights. Fixed Assets & Capital Governance Own and govern the end-to-end fixed asset lifecycle, including capitalization policies and asset registers. Lead the capitalization, asset classification, and impairment considerations. Oversee Capex governance to ensure compliance with budgets, policies, and DOA. Ensure effective handover of completed projects from Development to Asset Management. Ensure all development Capex is raised, tracked, and controlled through PMWeb. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership Act as the primary finance governance interface for Development, Asset Management, Treasury, Shared Services, Regional and Group Finance, and Auditors. Provide advice on funding structures, cash flow controls, and financial risk management. Monitor economic, regulatory, and real estate market developments and advise leadership accordingly. Required Skills To Be Successful: Deep expertise in IFRS and accounting standards. Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities. Proficient in financial reporting and analysis. About Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate The real estate development and operations arm of Al-Futtaim, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi-billion-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years. Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us. AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.

Enterprise leadership breadth — tight partnership with delivery, finance, legal, and CS will stretch your influence far beyond the traditional sales lane, preparing you for broader commercial leadership. If you believe the best salespeople are also the most disciplined operators — and you want an environment that proves it — we should connect.
